notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-medium-3-25-05, redirects to /models/mistral-medium-3-25-05). It is a product/model catalog page (release month, context 128k, multimodal, Premier tier, API id mistral-medium-2505, features, deprecation), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables, no WEIGHTS tab (no params/license). Modality icons are present but icon-only labels were not available as plain text; modalities recorded as the page's word 'multimodal'. The launch blog (https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-medium-3/) has capability charts and human-eval claims but was not used; seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
